messages:
alicia: SAST CI started failing after the keystore RBAC change ~25m ago, scanners getting 403 on KMS Decrypt. Any oncall?
marco: Confirmed in staging. Error: `PermissionDenied: Decrypt` — PR 3189 changed bindings to infra-readers and looks like svc-scan-runner isn't in that group.
secbot: [alert] CI job 7120 failed: sast-scan https://ci.redwood.example/jobs/7120 :rotating_light:
samira: tagging @owen — quick unblock plan? We can't ship with SAST red.
owen: Short-term: grant svc-scan-runner explicit decrypt role for 1h, long-term add smoke test to RBAC rollout. Which SA is used?
alicia: Pipeline SA = `svc-scan-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. PR 3189 rolled about 25m ago.
marco: gcloud command we'll use:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding svc-scan-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --member=serviceAccount:svc-scan-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
samira: Do it but capture binding id and ensure KMS audit logs are ingested (protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt"). We need evidence.
owen: Applying ephemeral binding now (bind-id: tmp-bind-1832). Will queue rerun when done.
alicia: Creating incident INC-2026-0942 for tracking and postmortem.
secbot: [incident] INC-2026-0942 created by alicia. PagerDuty paged.
marco: Triage checklist: 1) ephemeral grant, 2) rerun SAST, 3) collect KMS audit slice, 4) rollback PR if persists, 5) add mock-decrypt to RBAC rollout.
owen: Ephemeral grant applied. Re-run requested.
secbot: [automation] Re-run requested for CI job 7120 by owen.
alicia: Re-run green. Owen please revoke and pause rollout.
owen: Revoking binding now. Also opening PR to add a smoke-test step to the RBAC deploy (mock decrypt as effected SA).
samira: I'll update runbook "SAST KMS decrypt failures" with the ephemeral-grant play and smoke-test example.
marco: I'll pull KMS audit logs and attach to the incident time window 1832123200-1832124000.
alicia: I'll own the postmortem. Assign follow-ups in INC-2026-0942. Small but important: explicit SA mappings in infra docs. :thumbsup:
